candidate: target-free dip-rate HMM learned per-well scale gate
objective: Improve pooled RMSE over the fixed HMM overlay while reducing harmful-well tail risk.
target: Per-well SSE-optimal multiplier of the already frozen 0.20 HMM correction, clipped to [0, 1].

selection_rule.primary: Lowest spatial-protocol pooled RMSE among candidates that improve every spatial fold versus the base.
selection_rule.confirmation: The spatial-selected candidate must improve every Typewell fold, have pooled delta <= -0.05, p95 well delta <= 0, worst well delta <= 0.25, and well win fraction >= 0.65.
selection_rule.deployment: Fit the frozen selected model on all non-test training wells and apply only from target-free runtime features. No fixed test-well branch is permitted.
